question: P and Q can complete a work in 14 days and 21 days, respectively. They started doing the work but after 4 days P had to leave and Q alone completed the remaining work. The whole work was completed in how many days?
solution:
**Given:**

P and Q can complete a work in 14 days and 21 days, respectively.

They started doing the work but after 4 days

Q alone completed the remaining work. 

**Calculation:**

Efficiency (work/day) Days Total Work

**42/14 = 3 unit/days P -----> 14 **
